items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I'd come out and play with Shorty Allen. He had a trio and the bosses liked me

ctx.x: then after I left Wells', then... What had happened..we went in there with a show called "No Time for Squares" and it was an all colored review. Timmy was the star and we had chorus girls and what not. And so afterwards, you know, I didn't want to go right home so I'd come out and play with Shorty Allen. He had a trio and the bosses liked me and so after the engagement I just staid on there. I forgot about the Elegante, yeah.
But then a point was reached where you said, "things went bad," and you started regularly doing these...
